title: The Soul Loosed in Sickness: A Typology of Mystical Seeing
description: Heavily damaged but recoverable in outline: men in whom, during a brief sickness, the soul is loosed forth from the body so that the body's eye "blossoms" into mystical sight. A typology sorts these seers by manner and duration — those whose soul departs and returns within one and the same hour, those who linger before coming back to their feet, groupings of seven and three — and by direction: some shown the Deep, others the Light, according to the quality of soul that goes forth.
